title: Rain at Recess
intro: Dark clouds fill the sky over the school playground. Kabir hears thunder. His teacher looks up at the sky.

sections.title: What will happen next? Circle the best answer.
Match each clue to what will happen.

items.left: Mama takes out flour and sugar
Kabir yawns and rubs his eyes
The puppy sees an open gate

sections.title: Kabir has no umbrella. Is this a good prediction?

items.q: Kabir will get wet if he goes out now.
The sun will shine brightly in one minute.
The playground will be wet after the rain.
The children will swim in the playground.

sections.title: Write will or won't.

items.q: Look at the clouds! It ___ rain soon.
It is raining hard, so we ___ play outside today.
The puddles ___ dry up when the sun comes out.

sections.title: What will Kabir do after the rain stops? Write one sentence with will.
sections.a: e.g. Kabir will jump in the puddles. Check the sentence uses will.

sections.title: What will Dev do with his new toys tomorrow? Write one sentence.
sections.a: e.g. Dev will play with his new train. Check the sentence uses will.

sections.title: What do you think will happen to the red kite? Write one sentence.
sections.a: e.g. The kite will fall into the sea. Accept any sensible idea that uses will.
